questions_and_answers.question_text: Translate into Japanese Student A: 'Extension 397, please.'
Translate into Japanese Student B: 'Please wait a moment.'
Translate into Japanese Student B: 'Personnel Division.'
Translate into Japanese Student A: 'I'm (name) from the American Embassy. May I speak to Mr. Murakami?'

answers.answer_text: Amerika Taishikan no (name) desu ga, Murakami-san onegai shimasu.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Translate into Japanese Student B: 'Please wait a moment.'
Translate into Japanese Student A: 'Hello. Is this the accounting section?'

answers.answer_text: Moshi moshi. Keeri-ka desu ka? (OR Keeri-ka de gozaimasu ka?)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Translate into Japanese Student B: 'Yes, it is.'

answers.answer_text: Hai, soo desu. (OR Hai, sayoo de gozaimasu.)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Translate into Japanese Student A: 'May I speak to (B's name)?'
Translate into Japanese Student B: 'Speaking.'
Translate into Japanese Student A: 'May I speak to Mr. Kitamura?'
Translate into Japanese Student B: 'Who is calling, please?'

answers.answer_text: Shitsuree desu ga, donata desu ka?
